definitions.explanation: A scientific law or general principle that describes a consistent pattern or relationship in nature or society.

examples.japanese: ⟦{物理|ぶつり}→物理：03609_butsuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{法則|ほうそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: To learn the laws of physics.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{法則|ほうそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦ニュートン→ニュートン：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧{法則|ほうそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}した→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: I studied Newton's laws of motion.

notes:
{法則|ほうそく} refers to a law, rule, or principle that describes a consistent, observable pattern — especially in science and nature. Unlike ⟦{規則|きそく}→規則：01382_kisoku⟧ (man-made rules) or ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧ (legal laws), {法則|ほうそく} describes inherent patterns that are discovered rather than created.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧{法則|ほうそく}: laws of nature
- ⟦{物理|ぶつり}→物理：03609_butsuri⟧{法則|ほうそく}: laws of physics
- {法則|ほうそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}する→発見する：26929_hakkensuru⟧: to discover a law
- {法則|ほうそく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧: to follow/obey a law
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{法則|ほうそく}: the law of ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {法則|ほうそく}: scientific/natural law or principle
- ⟦{規則|きそく}→規則：01382_kisoku⟧: regulation, man-made rule
- ⟦{原則|げんそく}→原則：11801_gensoku⟧: general principle, fundamental rule
- ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧: legal law, statute
